subject: Dinner Friday?
text:
Hi,

Sorry if this feels last minute. I have a sudden issue with my rent, and the extra late fee pushed my budget off, so I am trying to cut back for the next month.

I was still wondering if your friend would like to come for dinner Friday at six. We can make it casual, nothing fancy, and I can walk over if it is easier. I only ask now because I have to decide whether to skip groceries or treat everyone simply.

If it is inconvenient, just say so. I do not need an explanation. If it works, tell me how many are coming and what food would be least hassle to bring.

I am running to class now, so I might be slow to answer later. Please reply even if the answer is no.
